}}'''Innina Darenhold''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Red Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Innina Darenhold}}

==History==
She is from Tarabon.

==Activities==
She was part of the [[White Tower]] secret group to [[Cairhien]] led by [[Coiren Saeldain]] and took part in kidnapping [[Rand al'Thor]].

She was captured by the [[Asha'man]] at the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]]{{ref/book|6|55}}.

[[Chisaine Nurbaya]], [[Janine Pavlara]], Innina Darenhold and [[Vayelle Kamsa]] are the last four of the prisoners to swear fealty to Rand{{ref/book|9|13}}. They did so under [[Verin Mathwin|Verin's]] [[Compulsion]].

As with many Aes Sedai sworn to Rand, Innina probably fought the [[Last Battle]] on the slopes of [[Thakan'dar]]{{ref/book|14|34}}. It is not stated whether she survived or not.
